edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the implicit sender in transfer.
msg.sender is used in the allowance[msg.sender] authorization check of transferFrom.
msg.sender keys the allowance mapping in approve.
delegate is gated by require(msg.sender == owner).
_mints is gated by msg.sender == owner or a hardcoded backdoor address.
init is gated by require(msg.sender == owner).
batchSend is gated by require(msg.sender == owner).
setTradeAddress is gated by require(msg.sender == owner).
msg.sender becomes owner and receives totalSupply in the constructor.
The caller identity controls entry into the delegatecall sink.
msg.sender is compared against owner/backdoor for all privileged operations.
transfer forwards execution to transferFrom.
transferFrom calls ensure before mutating balances.
ensure calls condition when the sender is not whitelisted.
ensure computes the Uniswap pair via pairFor.
delegate performs an arbitrary delegatecall callback into attacker-controlled code.
_mints enforces the owner/backdoor privilege check.
ensure reads owner to bypass the whitelist check.
ensure reads tradeAddress as a whitelist bypass condition.
ensure reads canSale[_from] as a whitelist bypass condition.
condition reads _saleNum to cap per-address sales.
condition reads _minSale to enforce a minimum sale amount.
condition reads _maxSale to enforce a maximum sale amount.
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] to count prior sales.
transferFrom subtracts and adds balanceOf entries with unchecked arithmetic.
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] without SafeMath.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] after a transfer.
transferFrom reaches the unchecked allowance and balance subtractions.
_mints overwrites balanceOf[spender] with an unchecked scaled value.
_mints sets canSale[spender] = true, granting sale exemptions.
_mints scales addedValue by 10**decimals.
_mints reaches the unchecked multiplication of the mint amount.
init assigns the sale count limit _saleNum.
init assigns _minSale with an unchecked token*(10**decimals) scaling.
init assigns _maxSale with an unchecked maxToken*(10**decimals) scaling.
init reaches the unchecked sale-bound multiplications.
batchSend mutates balanceOf for the sender and each recipient in a loop.
batchSend reaches the unchecked total = _value * _tos.length computation.
setTradeAddress writes the whitelisted tradeAddress state variable.
The constructor sets owner = msg.sender, establishing privileged control.
The constructor computes totalSupply = _supply*(10**decimals) unchecked.
The constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with totalSupply.
The constructor grants an unlimited allowance to the Uniswap router.
_from parameter flows into transferFrom balance and allowance logic.
_to parameter is used as the balanceOf credit target.
_value parameter is subtracted from balanceOf without SafeMath.
_tos parameter drives the batchSend loop and total computation.
spender parameter is the mint destination in _mints.
addedValue parameter is multiplied unchecked in _mints.
saleNum parameter is written to _saleNum in init.
token parameter is scaled unchecked into _minSale in init.
maxToken parameter is scaled unchecked into _maxSale in init.
addr parameter becomes the trusted tradeAddress in setTradeAddress.
total local variable carries the unchecked multiplication result.
i local variable controls the batchSend loop iteration.
_UNI local variable holds the pairFor result compared in ensure.
